title: Instant panic on opening any .go file
body:
Bisect suggests https://github.com/helix-editor/helix/commit/ddbf03613d5a3dd64f3f5ba13795e70c29297837 may be the culprit. `git revert`ing it over master fixes the crash, but I assume there's a better way to solve this than reverting an update.
### Reproduction steps
